com.codedstream.otterstream.remote.sagemaker.SageMakerProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:

public class SageMakerProvider extends Object implements InferenceProvider
InferenceProvider for AWS SageMaker endpoints, discovered automatically by OtterRuntime via ServiceLoader when this module is on the classpath.

    • createEngine

      public InferenceEngine<?> createEngine()
      Description copied from interface: InferenceProvider
      Creates a new, uninitialized InferenceEngine instance.

      The caller is responsible for calling InferenceEngine.initialize(com.codedstream.otterstream.inference.config.ModelConfig). A fresh instance must be returned on every call; engines are stateful once initialized and must never be shared across concurrent deployments.

      Specified by:
      createEngine in interface InferenceProvider
      Returns:
      a new engine instance ready to be initialized
